summary: Avalanche Software and Ritual Entertainment's cops-and-robbers third-person shooter.

entries.title: 25 to Life

emulation.emulator: Native Windows or xemu/PCSX2 for console online preservation
emulation.notes: Use Windows for the main route; original Xbox replacement-server play is optional preservation context.

primary.why: 25 to Life released for PlayStation 2, Xbox, and Windows, with online play on all three original platforms. Windows is the highest-fidelity route and included a Street Warriors playing-card pack-in for customers at launch.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version if legally owned; use original Xbox with replacement server support only if preserving online console play matters.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern remaster is documented in the cited public source.
